description: Fetch the fully rendered HTML of any web page through ScrapeUnblocker, bypassing anti-bot protection (Cloudflare, DataDome, PerimeterX, Akamai, Shape). Use this when a normal fetch is blocked (403/429, captcha, 'access denied') or when the page needs a real browser to render. Returns the raw HTML as text. To read or summarise a page, fetch_markdown is much smaller. To click, type or scroll before capturing, use browse_page.

method_timeout_seconds.description: Cap in seconds for the render-wait method.

proxy_country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to route through, e.g. 'US', 'GB', 'DE'.

sleep_seconds.description: Extra seconds to wait after load before capturing the HTML.

wait_method.description: Optional render-wait strategy: 'css' waits for a selector, 'js' waits for a JS expression to be truthy.

wait_value.description: The CSS selector or JS expression paired with wait_method (e.g. '#price' or 'document.readyState==="complete"').

name: fetch_html
title: Fetch page HTML
